# Blast V2 contracts

> Sui Move Boosts, funSUI/blastSUI liquid staking, partner codes and shared administration.

Launchpad, standalone presale, migrators, launch-ticket templates, presale testkit
and vendor presale adapters moved to [blast-v2-move](https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-move).
Use that repository's [llm.txt](https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-move/blob/main/llm.txt),
[launchpad reference](https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-move/blob/main/llms/launchpad.txt),
or [presale reference](https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-move/blob/main/llms/presale.txt).

## Integrator references retained here

- [Boosts](llms/boosts.txt): leverage coins backed by Aftermath perpetuals.
- [blastSUI and funSUI](llms/blast-sui.txt): single-validator staking vault.
- [Partners](llms/partners.txt): shared partner registry used by these products.
- [Administration](llms/admin.txt): shared ACL, operational versions and upgrade custody.
- [Full reference](llms-full.txt): the retained products and their source APIs.

Generated references join the authored [guides](docs/llms/AUTHORING.md) with exact
Move types, functions, events and errors. Run `python3 scripts/gen_llms.py` after
changing an included API or guide; CI checks freshness.

## Contributor routing

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) before editing source. Source and tests own behavior;
manifests, lockfiles and publication records own dependency and deployed lineage
facts. [Architecture](docs/architecture.md), [decisions](docs/decisions/README.md),
[scope](docs/protocol-scope.md), [testing](docs/testing.md),
[deployment records](deployments/README.md) and [domain language](CONTEXT.md)
provide context on demand.

Each Move.toml defines one package. Retained source includes `sui/boosts/`,
`sui/blast_sui`, `sui/admin`, `sui/partners`, `sui/coin_template` and `scratch-sui/`.
Shared admin and partner code stays here for the existing consumers; the new
repository includes fresh sources without first-party deployment metadata.
Composition tests and the parked DEX pin their launchpad dependency to the new
repository. Historical publication records stay here with their original source
identities; moving source does not republish or upgrade a package.

Blast uses Sui mainnet only. A package's `Published.toml`, when present, names its
current package ID and original type identity. Existing records remain historical
evidence even when the package's current source moved. See
[ADR 0134](docs/decisions/0134-launchpad-presale-repository-boundary.md) for the split.
